notablePrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Gruul Turf.
description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding {R/G}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Gruul Turf.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Gruul Turf.
Repeat.
